title: Telangana plans to move Classes 11-12 out of its separate Intermediate system into state-run schools from 2027-28: CM A. Revanth Reddy directed officials at an education review on Wed 11 Nov 2026 (three stages: nursery-Class 4, 5-8, 9-12, CBSE lines); the CM says about 40% of students drop out after Class 10 and 18 states already run 10+2; junior college staff keep service and retirement benefits; no government order reported; board runs under the 1971 Intermediate Education Act; the same merger was deferred in May 2026; lecturers' groups warned of statewide protests
